workflow.critical: Communicate in {communication_language}. Chains the 3 prompts. Each prompt keeps its own rules and stop point; between prompts the user confirms. Every step ends with its own mandatory REVIEW AND FIX pass (find issues in its own output, fix them, report found/fixed/open) before the confirmation question. Browser visible unless the user asked for headless.

step.action: If {output_folder}/EXECUTION-GUIDE.md is missing or has TODO values → run workflows/setup first
Run workflows/write-test-cases for each story argument (several files of one feature = one story folder)
step.ask: Show file list + counts. Ask: "Review the test cases. Execute now?" WAIT for yes.

step.goal: Prompt 1 — execute, one file at a time
step.action: For each generated test-case file in INDEX.md order: run workflows/execute-tests, then show the summary
step.ask: After each file ask: "Continue with next file?" Stop on no. Respect data-change approvals from the guide.
List Open bugs from BUGS-INDEX.md. Ask which to fix (none / all / pick). Fixing needs source access and a build.
step.action: For each chosen bug run workflows/fix-bug, then re-run the file that found it with workflows/execute-tests

step.output: Totals per story/file, bugs by severity and status, pass-rate vs {min_pass_rate}%, recommendation.
